items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed. Exact decision: keep new public exposure and security-sensitive releases gated because fleet-doctor has no run, findings, or checks; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; and authentication/access boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness remain unevidenced. Risk is high for security-sensitive clearance and unknown for ordinary reversible growth. Permit the canonical allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement only after capacity release, provided it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior and passes the stated validation and rollback gates. No clean bill of health or certification is claimed.

Complete the existing read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record dated evidence, owners, affected scope, severity, and release implications for authentication/access boundaries, secrets, container isolation, release/deploy controls, dependency provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident signals, and security.txt or disclosure readiness. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, or request duplicate telemetry.
